mentions.name: Collectibles Market Operational Dashboard
mentions.description: This app provides a unified operational dashboard for solo entrepreneurs in the collectibles market, consolidating eBay shopping, WorthPoint comps, LiveAuctioneers auction browsing, and HathiTrust/institutional research into one interface instead of 15 separate dashboards. It also plans custom intake pipelines that manage hundreds of keyword search terms to surface hidden vintage travel and tourism material.
mentions.problem: A keyword crisis in the collectibles market: if a seller doesn't put the right keyword in a listing or a buyer doesn't use the right search query, the two never meet; dealers must manage hundreds of search terms across many separate dashboards just to find specific hidden items.
mentions.audience: Solo entrepreneurs in the collectibles market, including antique dealers and collectibles curators
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building an operational dashboard for solo entrepreneurs in the collectibles market.
